component.name: OctoVault
component.summary: Protect local folders and manage encrypted backups

description.p: OctoVault brings encrypted local vaults and independent encrypted backups into one native GNOME application, with a matching command-line interface.

Create and manage vaults, move folders safely, configure desktop events, schedule backups, browse snapshots, and restore files. Keep portable recovery information outside the computer so your data remains recoverable.
Developed by Vast Development Method as part of the OctoLeo Suite.
Initial release of vault management, independent encrypted backups, native GNOME controls, and command-line access.
